properties.notes: Application for the construction of nine dwellings with associated access road, driveways and private gardens and the refurbishment and extension of the existing bungalow at 127a Station Road (to include the addition of a first floor and new roof), following demolition of existing buildings. Planning Ref: 12/00942/FUL (2012-12-12); 14/00315/FUL (2014-11-04); 15/00953/FULMAJ (2016-0714); 15/01040/OUT (2016-07-14); 16/01032/REM (2017-01-31); 16/00292/FUL (2017-02-06). 7 dwellings under construction at March 2019.
